nodes.name: Mining mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Vein Reader
choices.text: Ores within 3 blocks of the one you mine sparkle for 5 s.

choices.name: Stonebreaker
choices.text: +25% mining speed on stone, deepslate and netherrack.

nodes.name: Prospector
nodes.text: +5% chance to double raw ore and gem drops.

choices.name: Digger (B)
choices.text: +10% shovel speed and -5% shovel durability loss.

nodes.name: Gentle Hands
nodes.text: Pickaxes and shovels lose durability 30% slower.

nodes.name: Crafting mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Brewmaster
choices.text: Brewing stands you use brew 30% faster.

nodes.name: Arcane Insight
nodes.text: Your enchanting table can roll level V enchants.

nodes.name: Alchemist
nodes.text: Brewing is 25% faster; splash and lingering potions spread 20% wider.

nodes.name: Master Smith
nodes.text: The anvil "Too Expensive!" limit is 10 levels higher.

nodes.name: Runic Memory
nodes.text: Combining enchanted books never adds repair penalty.

nodes.name: Building mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Long Reach
choices.text: +1 block reach while holding a building block.

choices.name: B
choices.text: +5% breaking speed on blocks you placed

choices.name: Nimble (B)
choices.text: +10% breaking speed on blocks you placed.

nodes.name: Quick Hands
nodes.text: +25% block placing speed; climb scaffolding 25% faster.

nodes.name: Steady Footing
nodes.text: No fall damage from scaffolding, ladders and vines up to 10 blocks.

nodes.name: Master Builder
nodes.text: +3 block reach and you place blocks twice as fast.

nodes.name: Rebuilder
nodes.text: Inside your claimed areas, blocks you placed break instantly and go straight back to your inventory.

nodes.name: Gathering mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Forester
choices.text: +25% chopping speed, and saplings drop 25% more often.

nodes.name: Timberjack
nodes.text: +15% chopping speed; leaves drop saplings 25% more often.

nodes.name: Green Thumb
nodes.text: Bone meal on crops works 25% better.

nodes.name: Exploring mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Sea Legs
choices.text: +30 s of oxygen and +15% swim speed.

nodes.name: Deep Diver
nodes.text: +60 seconds of oxygen and you see 30% further underwater.

nodes.name: Naturalist
nodes.text: Familiar and Mastered need 15% fewer blocks.

nodes.text: +3% XP from new biomes and structures
